newsitem.title: USA: Dresser Drilling sets ABB Seatec alliance.
newsitem.headline: Dresser Drilling sets ABB Seatec alliance.

text.p: Dresser Drilling and Production Operations said Tuesday it signed a memorandum of understanding with ABB Seatec Ltd to establish an alliance for the development and sale of intelligent completions and surface control systems.

"Intelligent Completions" is the term used to encompass products and technologies for monitoring and controlling reservoir performance over a well's life cycle with the minimum of well intervention operations, the Dresser Industries Inc subsidiary said.
ABB Seatec is an ABB Group company.
With this alliance including surface control systems, a complete systems package, from the reservoir to shore operations, will be provided, Dresser said.
It said the alliance will focus its efforts specifically on multilateral completions and subsea wells, where the current cost of well intervention is extremely high.
The long-term goal of the alliance is to develop "closed-loop" systems that require no intervention operations and no communication/power line links to the surface.
